research_question: Establish the pre-finetune ESConv eight-class strategy baseline for the un-finetuned Qwen3.8-27B (Alibaba DashScope first-party API) under the same frozen prompts, the same fixed-250 item order, and the same official ESConv scoring used by the 2026-08-09/08-13 arms, so that a post-finetune run can be compared as a paired pre/post pair.

target_arms.label: Qwen3.8-27B, Alibaba DashScope first-party API (un-finetuned pre-test)

upstream_reference.note: The provider does not attest which revision it serves; this sha records the public checkpoint the fine-tune will start from, not a served-weights claim.

augesc.evaluation_rule: No independent test accuracy; use the held-out ESConv test set for downstream utility.

scores.mr: Accuracy, Completeness, Temporal Consistency, No Hallucination; each 0-5
scores.tcr: Temporal Accuracy, Causal Coherence, Completeness, No Hallucination; each 0-5

cpcd.reporting: Report raw 0-5 means and normalized quality percent. Never relabel the normalized score as Accuracy.

esconv.tokenizer: NLTK word_tokenize, lowercase, matching the released evaluator
esconv.ppl_policy: Do not report cross-provider PPL because DeepSeek is a black-box API and token likelihoods are unavailable.

fixed250_definition.selection: first 250 rows of the frozen test file in file order (`--limit 250`)
fixed250_definition.scoring: missing and invalid outputs count as wrong; denominator is 250

contamination_boundary.current_scope: Unmodified DeepSeek and Qwen base-model comparison only.
contamination_boundary.future_adapter: The research-v0 adapter uses CPCD, ESConv, and AugESC source text, so these benchmarks cannot be claimed as independent unseen tests after that training.

supersedes_note: Addendum to jingshi-cpcd-esconv-20260813-siliconflow-qwen-v1. The 8/13 protocol pinned Qwen3.6-27B on SiliconFlow; SiliconFlow does not serve Qwen3.8-27B (only Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a different model). The base model was changed to Qwen3.8-27B by owner decision on 2026-08-28.

thinking_control_verification.method: Two identical single-turn requests to qwen3.8-27b, temperature 0, differing only in whether enable_thinking:false was sent.

provider_default.verdict: thinking enabled by default, consistent with the model card

thinking_control_verification.conclusion: DashScope honours enable_thinking:false. The arm is frozen with that override; any run whose responses carry reasoning_content or reasoning_tokens is invalid under this protocol and must be discarded, not repaired.

provenance_limitations.detail: DashScope returns system_fingerprint = null. The 8/09 and 8/13 arms recorded a provider fingerprint as model-identity evidence; this arm cannot. Provenance for this arm rests only on the echoed `model` field and the per-response id.
provenance_limitations.consequence: Report this arm's provenance strength as one tier below the SiliconFlow and DeepSeek arms. Do not describe it as fingerprint-verified.
provenance_limitations.known_prior_inconsistency: The 8/13 SiliconFlow judgements already carry a different fingerprint format (a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e) than the 8/09 batch (fp_a18b46594c_prod0820_fp8_kvcache_20260402); both must be disclosed side by side, never merged.

scope_of_this_addendum.out_of_scope: CPCD is NOT run under this addendum. CPCD generation plus its proxy judge would require ~3.55M + ~3.53M input tokens and paid quota; it is deferred by owner decision so it can be run back-to-back with the post-finetune arm under one judge batch, eliminating the temporal drift that already produced two incompatible judge fingerprints.
scope_of_this_addendum.cost: ESConv 250 items ≈ 136K input / 12K output tokens, inside the DashScope per-model free quota; no judge calls are required because eight-class scoring is exact match.

historical_reference_arms.note: Not run under this addendum; their frozen outputs already exist and are compared descriptively, not as a third arm of this protocol.

engineering_track_baselines.note: frozen 2,775-item test, not fixed-250; do not compare directly across protocols.
